Espresso has less caffeine per shot, around 63 milligrams, but is more concentrated per ounce. Cold brew tends to be stronger too, since it's often steeped longer at higher coffee-to-water ratios, so checking your specific drink's size and type matters more than assuming a flat number.

Soccer uses a round ball moved primarily with the feet, minimal protective gear, and continuous 90-minute play divided into two 45-minute halves with few stoppages.
